description: This file defines the 'SQSAdapter' class, implementing the 'IQueueAdapter' interface for integrating Amazon SQS streaming with Orleans. It manages message queuing, serialization, and stream-to-queue mapping, enabling Orleans streams to interact with AWS SQS.

classes.name: SQSAdapter
classes.description: Implements the Orleans 'IQueueAdapter' interface to connect Orleans streaming to AWS SQS, handling message serialization, queue management, and stream mapping.

methods.name: SQSAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SQS adapter with serializers, stream queue mapper, logger factory, connection string, service ID, and provider name.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates and returns an SQS adapter receiver for a specified queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a batch of messages to AWS SQS for a particular stream, handling stream tokens and queue initialization.
